name: com.google.zxing.client.android.CaptureActivity
description: The ZXing barcode-scanning library, as packaged by ZHScanQRCode, opens this Activity when an app asks to scan a QR code or barcode. It uses the camera to read the code and returns its contents to the app.
disableEffect: Apps that use this screen will lose their QR-code and barcode-scanning flow.
